description:
Stream your Windows PC to any device with native, GPU-accelerated remote desktop.

Remio Host turns your Windows PC into a streaming target that any Remio client (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows) can connect to over the local network or the internet.

Built from scratch with native WinUI 3 - no Electron, no browser wrappers. Full GPU-accelerated H.264/H.265 screen capture, loopback audio, multi-monitor support, drag-and-drop file transfer, clipboard sync, and gamepad passthrough. Runs as a Windows Service so it survives reboots and log-offs.

Includes built-in auto-updates via WinSparkle (EdDSA-signed end-to-end), so you always have the latest version with one click.
Remio Host 2.5.0 - a PC reached over Remote Desktop no longer gets
stuck reporting itself at the sign-in screen, plus keyboard, file and
reconnect fixes.

- Fixed a PC wrongly stuck at "the sign-in screen": on a PC you also
  reach over Remote Desktop, or a rented cloud PC, Remio Host could
  decide nobody was signed in and stay convinced of it for the whole
  session - and kept clipboard sync, file transfer and app launching
  switched off the entire time. It now looks at the desktop it is
  actually streaming.
- Fixed a held key being let go as you type: holding Shift while
  selecting with the arrow keys no longer breaks halfway.
- Fixed "reveal in folder" doing nothing: the folder now opens with
  the file selected.
- A brief network hiccup no longer interrupts the picture.
- Fixed keys and buttons staying stuck after another device takes over.
- Hardened file transfers: a file arriving from a paired device can no
  longer be made to write outside the folder it belongs in.
- New setting: "Command key sends the Windows key" for anyone driving
  this PC from a Mac-layout keyboard.
